mapper.insert: insert into ai_rag_task ( task_id, type, status, progress, message, rag_tag, error_details, retry_count, parent_task_id, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{task.taskId}, #{task.type}, #{task.status}, #{task.progress}, #{task.message}, #{task.ragTag}, #{task.errorDetails}, #{task.retryCount}, #{task.parentTaskId}, #{task.createdAt}, #{task.updatedAt} )
mapper.update: update ai_rag_task set status = #{task.status}, progress = #{task.progress}, message = #{task.message}, rag_tag = #{task.ragTag}, error_details = #{task.errorDetails}, retry_count = #{task.retryCount}, parent_task_id = #{task.parentTaskId}, updated_at = #{task.updatedAt} where id = #{task.id}
mapper.select: select id, task_id, type, status, progress, message, rag_tag, error_details, retry_count, parent_task_id, created_at, updated_at from ai_rag_task where task_id = #{taskId} limit 1

select id, task_id, type, status, progress, message, rag_tag, error_details, retry_count, parent_task_id, created_at, updated_at from ai_rag_task order by updated_at desc, id asc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select count(distinct rag_tag) from ai_rag_task
and rag_tag is not null and rag_tag != ''

select count(1) from ai_rag_task
and (status = 'FAILED' OR (status = 'COMPLETED' AND error_details IS NOT NULL)) AND created_at >= #{since} AND (retry_count IS NULL OR retry_count < 3)

select id, task_id, type, status, progress, message, rag_tag, error_details, retry_count, parent_task_id, created_at, updated_at from ai_rag_task where (status = 'FAILED' OR (status = 'COMPLETED' AND error_details IS NOT NULL)) AND created_at >= #{since} AND (retry_count IS NULL OR retry_count < 3) order by created_at desc

select id, task_id, type, status, progress, message, rag_tag, error_details, retry_count, parent_task_id, created_at, updated_at from ai_rag_task where status = 'PROCESSING' AND updated_at < #{before} order by updated_at asc
mapper.delete: delete from ai_rag_task where status = 'COMPLETED' AND error_details IS NULL AND created_at < #{before}
